name: github-pr-filter
description: A focused Chromium and Firefox extension for switching GitHub pull-request lifecycle views.

scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun test test
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:e2e:chromium && bun run test:e2e:firefox
scripts.test:e2e:chromium: bun run build && E2E_BROWSER=chromium bun test ./e2e/*.e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: bun run build && E2E_BROWSER=firefox bun test ./e2e/*.e2e.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:e2e:check
scripts.lint:firefox: bun run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/extension-firefox
scripts.build:firefox: bun run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/extension-firefox --overwrite-dest
